decisions.reason: Specialized particle therapy water phantoms serve a niche but growing proton/ion therapy market with long replacement cycles, and the firm is likely to keep supporting it even though its web presence shrank to a mention in 2019.
Small volume ionization chambers are core dosimetry consumables with decades-long catalog life and are needed for small-field and SRS QA.
This chamber complements the small-field portfolio and is tied to calibration services, so it fits the firm's established dosimetry business.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are a backbone reference-dosimetry product required by protocols, so keeping it carries little risk.
Relative dosimetry chambers are routinely used with water phantoms for beam commissioning and sell steadily alongside phantom systems.
Thimble chambers are staple dosimetry products with long lifecycles and recurring calibration revenue.
